title: 1RB0LB_1RC0LA_1LB0RD_1RE1RD_1RB1RF_1LA--- and its twin: the other stop rules in Lean, for every carry length
text: lean/Stops.lean proves the sweeps that stop on the odd walls and wall pairs of the exact rule table, the borrows, and the carries that stop on the bottom digit, for every chain of T digits and all run lengths: 44 symbolic pieces and 22 sweep theorems through one generic theorem, sweepGen, in both folders. With lean/Chain.lean this covers every stop part that keeps the far end as it is; the rules that change the far end, and the invariant a non-halting proof needs, are still open.
